description.value: The Table Bistro is an elevated artisanal bistro in the heart of Abbotsford's Fraser Valley, putting a creative twist on familiar regional ingredients. It features a fully operational cocktail bar, a curated wine list, and a café-quality coffee program. A touring cyclist finishing a Fraser Valley ride would find a full lunch and dinner menu, weekend brunch, and a daily happy hour.
